name: Zaccheus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Zaccheus was another bourgeois, a wealthy individual. “The chief among the publicans, and he was rich.” The publicans were the tax collectors for Rome.

note.label: THE BLACK BOULÉ & BOURGEOISIE IN THE BIBLE
